appDescription: A driving audio journal that finds and plays laughter-based highlight clips from saved recordings.

function.name: FIND_RECORDING_HIGHLIGHTS
function.description: Start local laughter-based highlight analysis of a saved recording and acknowledge the request while analysis continues.

recordingId.description: An already known recording identifier; omit it to analyze the most recent saved recording.

function.name: SHOW_RECORDING_HIGHLIGHTS
function.description: Display the most recently analyzed recording's saved laughter-based highlight candidates and their playback numbers.

function.name: PLAY_RECORDING_HIGHLIGHT
function.description: Play a saved highlight by its number in the displayed highlight list.

highlightNumber.description: The one-based highlight number from one to three in the displayed list.
